title: Understanding Star Schemas
text: Think about how star schemas organize data. They often centralize data in a way that reduces redundancy. How might this help with update errors?

title: Evaluating Data Duplication
text: Consider the role of data duplication in update errors. If data is duplicated across multiple tables, what happens when an update is made?

title: Centralized Data
text: In a star schema, data is often centralized in a fact table. How does this centralization affect the need to update data in multiple places?
